thread:
Maya (Support): heads-up: multiple customers (ACME, NoodleLabs, three smaller tenants) seeing 5xx/timeouts against hosted inference in eu-west since ~02:10 UTC. opening this thread to coordinate repro, mitigation, and customer comms. :warning:
Raj (Infra): seeing a clear spike in 502/504s from apigw -> runtime. p50/p95 latency jumped. attaching two sample req ids: rq_8f3a1, rq_8f3a2.
Leo (Runtime): got the ids, pulling runtime logs now. any common model or route?
Maya (Support): mostly /v1/generate, mix of long sequences and chat endpoints. customers reported repeated retries.
ops-bot: autoscaler triggered scale-up in eu-west at 02:12 UTC (+3 pods).
Emily (SRE): mitigation applied: temporarily disabled the incoming canary route and enabled model fallback for affected endpoints (small-model variant). also increased listener count in eu-west. monitoring for error rate drop.
Raj (Infra): evidence from apigw: connection pool exhaustion + a flurry of long requests that hold KV cache and kernels. paste of quick grep: 
```
apigw | 02:11:53 | rq_8f3a1 | 504 upstream timeout
runtime | 02:11:54 | rq_8f3a1 | kernel OOM while allocating KV cache
apigw | 02:12:01 | rq_8f3a2 | 502 bad gateway
```
Leo (Runtime): repro script that seems to trigger the issue (will push to gist). quick snippet: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-x-large","input":"<2000 token prompt>","max_tokens":4000,"temperature":0.9}'
```
Maya (Support): customer-facing status draft: "We're investigating an increase in 5xx errors affecting hosted inference in eu-west. We've applied temporary mitigations (fallback routing and scaling). We'll provide updates in ~30m and a post-incident summary after remediation." ok to send? :thinking_face:
Sofia (CS): I can send that as a short note to impacted customers now. add ETA line and we should offer a short workaround (reduce max_tokens or pin to smaller model) in the note.
Raj (Infra): suggested immediate hard caps per-tenant: limit concurrent requests to 4 and max tokens 2000 for now. this prevents large KV growth from a few tenants.
Emily (SRE): agree. action items I propose: 1) short-term caps (Raj) 2) restore keepalive config on runtime pools (Leo) 3) postmortem (owner: Emily) 4) customer comms & runbook updates (Sofia + Maya).
Leo (Runtime): I pushed a patch to increase keepalive and reduce pool idle_timeout to 30s. also added quick guard in runtime to reject requests with >3k token compute-heavy flags. will monitor.
Maya (Support): sending comms now (Sofia pls confirm once sent).
Sofia (CS): sent to impacted accounts, included workaround and expected ETA 90m. customers replied: asking for root cause and SLA credit. capturing replies and will escalate billing with finance if needed.
Raj (Infra): root-cause hypothesis: sudden increase in long-sequence generation requests + a canary route misrouting some traffic to a partially warmed pool -> KV cache churn + OOMs -> connections pile up -> apigw timeouts cascade. need to verify with traces.
Emily (SRE): agreed. assign owners: RC analysis (Emily), telemetry gap analysis (Raj), runtime hardening (Leo), comms + customer follow-up (Sofia & Maya). I'll schedule the postmortem meeting and draft the timeline.
Leo (Runtime): follow-up: I've added a lightweight per-request cost estimate metric to help block huge requests earlier. will ship hotfix to canary in 20m.
Maya (Support): thanks everyone. final ask: can we produce a short "repro handbook" (one-pager) with exact curl examples, logs to collect, and a customer script for workarounds? that'll make support handoffs smoother. who picks this up?
Emily (SRE): I'll own the handbook draft + postmortem writeup. target: initial draft in 6h, full postmortem in 48h.
Sofia (CS): I'll collect customer impact notes and save all comms.
Raj (Infra): I'll run a deeper correlation between seq-len distribution and tenant IDs, and add an alert to detect sudden percentile shifts.
Maya (Support): wrapping up: mitigations in place, error rate trending down (~70% reduction), customers notified, postmortem owners assigned. set a checkpoint at +30m to confirm resolution. :white_check_mark:
